journey.title: Assurance gate chain and review flow (#143, #144, #145, #136, #135, #146)

decisions.decision: Target repository alphazede/bearing-lite (main @ 174773e, v1.1.3); Lifecycle worked in worktree /home/spectre/src/bearing-lite-agr on branch feat/assurance-gate-review-flow; plan directory docs/plans/2026-09-22-assurance-gate-and-review-flow/.
decisions.source: Intake FIT_PROPOSED confirmed via owner answer

decisions.decision: Scope: issues #143, #144, #145 plus related #136 and #135. Out of scope: #139, #122, #92.
Profile: primary. Snapshot recorded in profile_selection is authoritative for this Lifecycle.

Planning stages without a profile route use the frozen snapshot route of the closest role: Architectural Alignment -> systems_modeler.planning; Scope Definition -> requirements_engineer.planning; Planning and Design -> plan_integrator. Every stage is dispatched as a separate process with BEARING_ROLE in its environment.
decisions.source: owner instruction 'use what we have in the roles'

decisions.decision: Add #146 (orchestrator_write_lock blocks Orchestrator-owned Architectural Alignment; in-process subagents cannot carry BEARING_ROLE) to Lifecycle scope. #139 stays out of scope.

Owner amendment to DEC-AGR-004: Architectural Alignment, including Scope Definition, is owned by the planning Orchestrator for this Lifecycle. Scope Definition runs in the Orchestrator session. The already-written workspace.md (Muse route) is retained. Planning and Design and specialist roles keep snapshot routes via separate processes with BEARING_ROLE set. This deviates from current skill text pending #146.

Architectural Alignment and Scope Definition become Orchestrator-owned: orchestrator-write-lock allows Orchestrator writes to workspace.md and repository-map.md; skill text matches. Specialist artifacts stay role-locked. The hook also learns in-process subagent roles from the host envelope where a harness exposes them; otherwise the fallback is a separate process with BEARING_ROLE, named in the deny message; a subagent is never silently treated as the Orchestrator.
decisions.source: Scope Definition shared understanding confirmed by owner

decisions.decision: At a boundary with no Assurance Test Engineer receipt, the Reviewer consumes the #143 deterministic gate-chain receipt for that unit; neither receipt is a typed gap, never PASS. Therefore the gate chain runs at every Reviewer boundary.
decisions.source: Scope Definition shared understanding confirmed by owner

decisions.decision: Actionable findings require file:line plus a failing test or reproducer; others are advisory and cannot produce REPAIR_REQUIRED or BLOCK. Reviewer scope narrows to what gates cannot prove; Assurance Test Engineer does not re-review code. Finding classifier DEFERRED to AlphaZedeHQ #148 / bearing-lite #122 (owner-approved destination).
decisions.source: Scope Definition shared understanding confirmed by owner

decisions.decision: Fixed fail-fast gate chain: build, types/lint, red-then-green, mutation score, changed-line coverage, Reverify, then Reviewer. Mutation and changed-line coverage are declared per plan in seit.json (repository tool + threshold); declared = hard gate, missing tool or not_run = typed gap; undeclared requires NOT_APPLICABLE with reason. Policy and hook mirror stay in sync via the drift test.
decisions.source: Scope Definition shared understanding confirmed by owner

decisions.decision: #136: owner-review gate cannot be presented before the DoD Manifest is generated. #135: replace prose-pinned live digests with a tool check plus an allow-list for historical records. Guard location and allow-list format are Planning and Design decisions.
decisions.source: Scope Definition shared understanding confirmed by owner

decisions.decision: Land on main by PR once checks are green. npm release ($publish-bearing-lite) is out of this Lifecycle and owner-only. Out of scope: #139, #122, #92.
decisions.source: Scope Definition shared understanding confirmed by owner

decisions.decision: OD-AGR-001 resolved: Reviewer receipt stays skill prose plus conformance test (DES-144.01); no new receipt schema in this Lifecycle.
decisions.source: owner answer at integrated review gate

decisions.decision: Integrated owner review APPROVED: planning package at feat/assurance-gate-review-flow 8718219 (plan-package manifest digest 4ab2675dbbc893c28109d65fabcbc329b25a071abbde8d13fdbecd4409b3187a; DoD Manifest sha256:500d2a17bf78a96b7c276d9c00f8511a279bb8e4afc502e582f97c2f38c8d015), frozen primary profile snapshot, tdd, cadence reviewer=phase, test_engineer.assurance=lifecycle, integration_engineer.execution=lifecycle. Lifecycle type: standard implementation. Authority: implement, land by PR when checks are green; no npm release.
